title: Unveiling the synergistic potential of LaMnO3–CeO2 composites in supercapacitor applications
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00726G, Paper
Open Access

Alisha Dhakal, Felio Perez, Sanjay R. Mishra
This study investigates the synthesis of LaMnO3–CeO2 composites with varying CeO2 contents ((100 − x)% LaMnO3–x% CeO2; x = 0, 10, 30, 50, 100 wt%) via an autocombustion method to elucidate their synergistic electrochemical properties.
